content:
BUILT CoLAB is supporting Porto de Mós City Council in its digital transition process. To this end, it has established a transversal plan with the municipality, the practical application of which began this March.

In this first phase of the plan’s implementation, BUILT CoLAB presented a session dedicated to Introducing the BIM Methodology. To this end, Pedro Lucas Martins, Luís Sanhudo, Débora Pinto and João Poças Martins presented the basic concepts of BIM to a wide range of municipal employees who will be involved in the process.

This session took place in person in the auditorium of Porto de Mós Town Hall and was attended by employees from the LUP – Licensing, Urbanisation and Planning Office, GIS, Private Works, Administrative Modernisation, Inspection, Environment, IT and Public Works departments, who showed great interest in the subject and involvement in its discussion.
